headline: Direct-sow fast fall greens now — spinach, arugula, radishes and lettuce still have time to mature before the mid-October frost.

tasks.title: Fast fall greens
tasks.detail: Direct-sow spinach, arugula, radishes, and leaf lettuce this week. With ~6 weeks to first frost they'll mature in time, and cool nights make them sweeter. Keep the seedbed watered daily until seedlings emerge.

tasks.title: Pick summer crops at peak
tasks.detail: Harvest tomatoes, zucchini, cucumbers, and beans every day or two. Frequent picking keeps plants setting more fruit before the season ends.

tasks.title: Late blight & powdery mildew
tasks.detail: Warm, humid late-summer days favor both. Remove affected leaves, water at the base rather than overhead, and thin crowded growth for better airflow.

tasks.title: Order seed garlic
tasks.detail: Buy hardneck seed garlic now while varieties are in stock. You'll plant the cloves in mid-to-late October for harvest next summer.

tasks.title: Deep, consistent watering
tasks.detail: Fruiting crops need about 1 inch of water per week. Water deeply in the morning so foliage dries fast and roots stay strong through late-summer heat.

tasks.title: Side-dress fall greens
tasks.detail: Give newly sown greens and any leafy crops a light feeding of compost or balanced fertilizer. Ease off nitrogen on tomatoes and squash you want to ripen down.
